layers.authority: Parques Nacionales Naturales de Colombia (PNN) with Cormacarena
layers.process: Caño Cristales (Serranía de La Macarena National Park): entry to the trails is through an authorised operator agency only; a local certified guide is required, one per group (sources give six or seven people per group). Operators arrange the daily entry permit with Cormacarena and PNN. Trails have a daily visitor limit.

layers.authority: Municipality of La Macarena, as reported
layers.process: Yellow fever vaccination is reported as required to enter La Macarena municipality.
The visiting season is reported as mid-June to late November or early December, depending on the rains.
